always_rules: **sentences[] in dictation.js and shadowing.js MUST be plain text (no `**bold**` markers)** — `content_en`/`content_vi` can have `**` for display, but sentences[] is fed directly to TTS ⚠️ **BUG-W27:** TTS reads `**` as 'star star'

**dictation.js sentences[] MUST use the same audio_url paths as shadowing.js** when text is identical — prevents double R2 storage and ensures audio consistency ⚠️ **BUG-W27:** dictation used `dictation_NNN.mp3` while shadowing used `shadowing_sN.mp3`, causing stale audio cache

**audio_url naming MUST use the `_sN` suffix pattern** (e.g. `shadowing_s1.mp3`) — NEVER use bare number suffix `_N` (e.g. `dictation_1.mp3`) which is the old W1-15 pattern ⚠️ **BUG-W27:** mixed naming caused R2 purge to miss files

**Easy mode word_power.js collocations may differ from Advanced** — always check ALL image_url filenames in BOTH weeks_easy and weeks data files before generating prompts; generate prompts for the UNION of both sets
**After ANY R2 audio purge, also clear browser IndexedDB** — R2 purge removes server cache but browser may still have old audio in IndexedDB (Layer 1 cache)
never_rules: NEVER copy sentences[] from read.js with `**bold**` markers directly into dictation.js or shadowing.js — strip all `**` before putting in sentences[]
NEVER use different audio_url patterns for dictation and shadowing when they share the same text — they must point to the same R2 file
NEVER assume R2 purge alone fixes stale audio — must also clear browser IndexedDB/site data

NEVER generate image prompts for only Advanced word_power without checking Easy word_power for additional unique collocations ⚠️ **BUG-W27:** 3 Easy-only collocations (grow_towards_the_sun, make_its_own_food, watch_it_grow) were missing images

NEVER use `node tools/generate_images_nano.js N` output as final prompts — the auto-generated descriptions use dictionary definitions, not visual scene descriptions; always rewrite with rich scene descriptions
real_js_checks: sentences[].text must contain NO `**` markdown markers — run: grep '\*\*' src/data/weeks/week_N/dictation.js src/data/weeks/week_N/shadowing.js (must return empty)

dictation.js and shadowing.js sentences[] must have matching audio_url paths when text is identical — cross-check with: diff <(grep audio_url src/data/weeks/week_N/dictation.js) <(grep audio_url src/data/weeks/week_N/shadowing.js | sed 's/shadowing/dictation/g')
